title: Diplomatic language
description: Soften disagreement and make polite suggestions at work.

introduction.headline: Disagree without offending
introduction.body: Learn hedging and softening phrases for sensitive conversations.
introduction.bodyIt: Impara frasi di attenuazione e softener per conversazioni delicate.
objectives: Use modal verbs for deduction and tact

vocabulary.example: A diplomatic reply can protect the relationship.
vocabulary.exampleTranslation: Una risposta diplomatica può proteggere la relazione.

vocabulary.example: You can hedge a strong opinion with might or seem.
vocabulary.exampleTranslation: Puoi attenuare un'opinione forte con might o seem.

vocabulary.example: I would suggest delaying the launch slightly.
vocabulary.exampleTranslation: Vorrei suggerire di ritardare leggermente il lancio.

options: I would suggest reconsidering the timeline.
exercises.answer: I would suggest reconsidering the timeline.
exercises.explanation: Would suggest softens the recommendation and sounds professional.

exercises.prompt: It ____ be better to check the figures again.
exercises.promptIt: Completa: It ____ be better to check the figures again.
exercises.explanation: Might softens a suggestion and leaves room for discussion.

review.tip: Rewrite one blunt disagreement using I would suggest or It might be better.
